item.description: A court in western Germany ordered the archdiocese of Cologne on Thursday to pay a woman €550,000 (US$600,000) in damages for sexual abuse. item.description: Net migration to the UK fell to 77,000 for the year to June, the lowest annual figure since 1997 excluding the Covid years, statistics showed on Thursday.
